THANJAI PERIYA KOVIL

தஞ்சை பெரிய கோவில்
Walk: W A S D or arrows, Shift to run. Drag to look. Aerial: drag to orbit, scroll to zoom. Remastered 3D world. Walk through the open east gateway; W/A/S/D to explore, Shift to run, drag to look. Narration and Tamil/English voice controls are in the bottom menu.
